A visual analytics study of a Spanish motor insurance portfolio (354,140 policy-years, 2022–2024).

## Deliverables

- 📊 [**Executive Summary (revealjs)**](presentation.html) — 15-slide presentation with speaker notes
- 📄 [**Technical Report (HTML)**](report.html) — fully reproducible analysis with code

## TL;DR

| Finding | Evidence |
|----|----|
| Portfolio LR deteriorated **65.6% → 74.7%** in 2 years | Aggregated LR by underwriting year |
| **Comp. (basic) at 93.9% LR** is the prime under-performer | LR by policy type |
| **Diesel runs 9 pp above gasoline** | LR by fuel type, χ² p \< 0.001 |
| **Top 5% of policies = 83% of losses** | Loss concentration curve |
| Semi-annual / quarterly payers signal **adverse selection** | LR by payment frequency |

Built with `tidyverse` for wrangling and `ggplot2` + extensions (`ggridges`, `ggdist`, `ggstatsplot`, `patchwork`) for visual analytics.
